stage_guidance.tree_generation: Decompose transportation questions into a table bridge lookup followed by a linked-document fact lookup when needed. Keep children executable and preserve [n] references exactly.
stage_guidance.source_selection: In transportation HybridQA, Table is the complete bound table and Text is its linked documents. Use Table for row values, rankings, dates, names, categories, and comparisons; Text for descriptive or relational prose; both for bridge questions.
stage_guidance.direct_answer: Return only evidence-compatible transportation entities, names, dates, counts, organizations, places, titles, or short phrases in the required Answer List format.
stage_guidance.direct_rag: Resolve the table candidate or bridge before extracting the final linked-document fact. Copy the final span faithfully and do not substitute unrelated prior knowledge.
stage_guidance.search: Identify only the requested current-hop entity or candidate from the supplied evidence; do not jump to a later-hop answer.
stage_guidance.relate: Return only the value connected to the named entity by the requested relation, preserving exact names, dates, quantities, and labels.
stage_guidance.filter: Apply every stated condition to the candidate set and return all and only matching entities.
stage_guidance.answer_from_child_qa: Fuse child answers in dependency order, resolve references, and exclude intermediate bridge entities unless the final question requests them.
